title: Docker: react-router not resolved after bun install on startup
description: After the startup bun install fix (website-ibv), Vite starts but fails dependency pre-bundling. It detects the lockfile changed (from the bind mount) and re-optimizes, but still cannot resolve react-router. Error: 'Failed to run dependency scan. Skipping dependency pre-bundling. react-router (imported by /app/front-end/src/components/TopBar.tsx) - Are they installed?' Likely the anonymous volume for /app/front-end/node_modules is still stale and the startup bun install only updates /app/node_modules at the root, not the workspace node_modules.
close_reason: Fixed two problems: (1) Removed anonymous volumes for workspace node_modules (/app/front-end/node_modules, /app/back-end/node_modules) from docker-compose.yml — these were overlaying the bind-mounted host directories with stale content. The host's node_modules (which has react-router) is now used directly via the bind mount. Kept the root /app/node_modules anonymous volume since root isn't bind-mounted. (2) Added missing workspace package.json to each Dockerfile dev stage (back-end/package.json in front-end, front-end/package.json in back-end) so the startup bun install can resolve all workspaces. Also removed the now-unnecessary COPY of workspace node_modules from deps stage.

title: Vite error
description: tsc -b fails with TS6059 and TS6307: shared/src/index.ts is not under rootDir (front-end) and not listed in tsconfig.node.json. Build command 'tsc -b && vite build' exits with code 2.
close_reason: Fixed by removing composite/outDir from tsconfig.node.json (replaced with noEmit) and removing it from front-end tsconfig project references. The tsconfig.node.json now only serves IDE support for vite.config.ts, not the tsc -b build chain. Root cause: vite.config.ts imports from ../shared/src/index which was outside the composite project's rootDir.

title: Vite fails to resolve react-router import in Docker
description: Vite import analysis plugin fails to resolve 'react-router' from src/App.tsx in the Docker container (/app/front-end/). The package is installed in the front-end workspace but Vite cannot find it at runtime. Error: [plugin:vite:import-analysis] Failed to resolve import "react-router" from "src/App.tsx".
close_reason: Fixed by: (1) bind-mounting root package.json (read-only) and bun.lock into both containers so dependency changes are visible, (2) running 'bun install' on container startup in both Dockerfiles (dev target CMD) to sync anonymous volume node_modules with current lock file. Root cause: anonymous Docker volumes for node_modules persisted stale deps across rebuilds.
